en.text: Welcome to the weapons room. The rack holds every weapon I know of, and the bench is where I make yours better.
en.description: A man in his mid-thirties, the gunsmith of a mining ship, talking to a crew member at his workbench in the weapons room. Medium baritone voice, quiet and thoughtful, with a craftsman's calm focus. Friendly and easygoing, curious, a little reflective, not gruff and not a soldier. Plain and conversational rather than narrating. Native English speaker with a neutral accent.

de.text: Willkommen im Waffenraum. Im Regal hängt jede Waffe, die ich kenne, und an der Werkbank mache ich deine besser.
